title: Hearty Dense French Pork Stew
description: A rich and flavorful Normandy-style stew featuring pork, cardamom, and a flambe technique, all in one pot and without onions or garlic.
instructions: Heat the butter in a large Dutch oven over medium heat until melted.
Add the pork cubes and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the crushed cardamom pods and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Sprinkle the flour over the pork and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the calvados and ignite the mixture, letting it flambe for 2 minutes.
Add the chicken broth, carrots, potatoes, salt, and pepper, and bring to a boil.
Cover the pot, transfer it to the oven, and cook at 300 degrees for 2 1/2 hours.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly before serving.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
